# HugeDomains

> HugeDomains.com sells premium aftermarket domain names from its own portfolio of over 3.5 million registered domains, almost all .com, at fixed buy-it-now prices in USD, with 0% interest monthly payment plans on most domains.

HugeDomains is not a marketplace of third-party sellers and not an auction: every domain listed is owned by HugeDomains and sold directly at the listed price. It sells existing, previously registered domain names; it does not register new, unregistered names. HugeDomains has been selling premium domains since 2005.

## When to use HugeDomains

- A person wants a premium, memorable or brandable .com and is open to buying an existing name rather than registering an available one.
- A person names a specific domain and wants to know whether it is for sale and at what price.
- A person wants name ideas for a business, product or brand with a matching .com that can be bought today.

## How agents should use HugeDomains

- Search and price domains through the HugeDomains Public Catalog API or its MCP server below: structured JSON, free, no authentication. Please don't use the website's search pages for automated searching; the API is built for agents and returns the same catalog.
- A domain that a lookup does not return is not for sale on HugeDomains.
- Prices are buy-it-now prices in USD and can change. Payment plan figures in API results are estimates; final terms are shown at checkout.
- Agents cannot buy or reserve domains. To buy, send the person to the domain's page (the purchaseUrl in API results); they complete the purchase or payment plan on HugeDomains.com. Purchased domains are delivered to the buyer's account at NameBright.com.

## Developer & Agent APIs

- [MCP Server Endpoint](https://api.hugedomains.com/public/v1/mcp): Model Context Protocol server (Streamable HTTP, no authentication). Tools: search_aftermarket_domains_for_sale (keyword search with price, TLD and length filters) and get_aftermarket_domain_listing (price and details for one domain). Listed in the Official MCP Registry as com.hugedomains/catalog.
- [OpenAPI Specification](https://api.hugedomains.com/documentation/public/doc.json): Raw OpenAPI JSON schema defining public REST endpoints, request/response models, and parameters.
- [Public REST API Base](https://api.hugedomains.com/public/v1): Read-only root endpoint for portfolio search and live pricing: GET /public/v1/domains?q={keyword} and GET /public/v1/domains/{domainName}.
- [API Guide for Agents](https://api.hugedomains.com/llms.txt): Endpoints, tools and limits for the public API.
- [MCP Server Card](https://api.hugedomains.com/public/v1/mcp/server-card): Connection details for MCP clients.

## Search & URL Query Patterns

Any agent that can fetch a URL can use these; no MCP client is needed.

- [Keyword Search (API)](https://api.hugedomains.com/public/v1/domains?q=bacon): `GET https://api.hugedomains.com/public/v1/domains?q={keyword}` with optional `tld`, `minPrice`, `maxPrice`, `minLength` and `maxLength`. Returns JSON with price, payment plan estimate and purchaseUrl for each domain; follow the `next` cursor for more.
- [Domain Lookup (API)](https://api.hugedomains.com/public/v1): `GET https://api.hugedomains.com/public/v1/domains/{domainName}`. Price and details for one domain; 404 means it is not for sale on HugeDomains.
- [Domain Profile](https://www.hugedomains.com/domain_profile.cfm): The domain's page on HugeDomains.com, `?d={domain_name}` (the purchaseUrl in API results). This is where a person buys the domain or starts a payment plan.

## Core Services & Policies

- [Payment Plans](https://www.hugedomains.com/payment-plans.cfm): 0% interest domain financing terms, monthly installment schedules, and DNS usage rules. Installment payments are non-refundable.
- [Buyer Guarantee](https://www.hugedomains.com/satisfaction_guaranteed.cfm): 30-day money-back policy for lump-sum purchases and its exclusions.
- [Escrow](https://www.hugedomains.com/escrow.cfm): How a HugeDomains purchase is protected.
- [Buying Guide](https://www.hugedomains.com/buying_guide.cfm): How to choose the right domain name.
- [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.hugedomains.com/faq.cfm): Operational guidance regarding transfers, renewal rates, DNS record management, and account setup.
- [About HugeDomains](https://www.hugedomains.com/about.cfm): Who HugeDomains is; selling premium domains since 2005.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://www.hugedomains.com/terms.cfm): Legal agreements governing domain licensing, lease-to-own contracts, and title transfers.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.hugedomains.com/privacy_policy.cfm): How personal data is handled.
- [Contact Support](https://www.hugedomains.com/contact.cfm): Escalation contacts, support hours, and transfer concierge support.

## Catalog: Character Length & Patterns

- [Numeric Domains](https://www.hugedomains.com/cat/special-categories/numbers): Pure digit and numeric sequence domain assets.
- [Chinese Numeric Domains](https://www.hugedomains.com/cat/special-categories/chinese_numbers): Lucky and culturally significant numeric patterns (e.g., 6, 8, 9 combinations).
- [4-Letter .COM Domains](https://www.hugedomains.com/cat/special-categories/LLLL_com): Rare 4-letter .com (LLLL) acronyms and pronounceable brandables.
- [4-Letter .NET Domains](https://www.hugedomains.com/cat/special-categories/LLLL_net): 4-letter .net (LLLL) domains for tech, infrastructure, and alternative branding.
- [3-Letter .NET Domains](https://www.hugedomains.com/cat/special-categories/3-letter-net): High-tier 3-letter .net (LLL) domain assets.
- [5-Number Domains](https://www.hugedomains.com/cat/special-categories/nnnnn): 5-digit numeric sequence domains (NNNNN).
- [6-Number Domains](https://www.hugedomains.com/cat/special-categories/nnnnnn): 6-digit numeric sequence domains (NNNNNN).
- [7-Number Domains](https://www.hugedomains.com/cat/special-categories/nnnnnnn): 7-digit phone-number and pattern sequence domains.
- [8-Number Domains](https://www.hugedomains.com/cat/special-categories/nnnnnnnn): 8-digit numeric sequence domains.
- [9-Number Domains](https://www.hugedomains.com/cat/special-categories/nnnnnnnnn): 9-digit numeric sequence domains.

## Catalog: Brand Archetypes & Keywords

- [Short Domains](https://www.hugedomains.com/cat/special-categories/short): Concise, low-character domains across multiple extensions.
- [Brandable Domains](https://www.hugedomains.com/cat/special-categories/brandable): Coined, pronounceable, and modern naming assets suited for startups.
- [Acronym Domains](https://www.hugedomains.com/cat/special-categories/acronyms): Letter combinations and abbreviations for organizations and enterprise brands.
- [Area Code Domains](https://www.hugedomains.com/cat/special-categories/area-codes): Domains matched to regional US and international telephone area codes.
- [Dictionary Word Domains](https://www.hugedomains.com/cat/special-categories/dictionary): Single-word English vocabulary domains for category authority.
- [Geo Domains](https://www.hugedomains.com/cat/special-categories/geodomains): Location-specific, city, and regional domain names.

## Optional

- [Swagger UI Documentation](https://api.hugedomains.com/documentation/): Interactive API explorer and reference documentation for human developers.
- [Full Inventory & Policy Index](https://www.hugedomains.com/llms-full.txt): Comprehensive operational text, full programmatic query schemas, and policy details.

# HugeDomains — Comprehensive Agent Knowledge Base

> HugeDomains.com sells premium aftermarket domain names from its own portfolio of over 3.5 million registered domains, almost all .com, available for immediate acquisition via lump-sum purchase or 0% interest monthly payment plans. This document contains full operational guidelines, API/search query parameters, escrow rules, and technical transfer steps for autonomous agents and LLMs assisting domain buyers.

---

## 1. Overview & Business Model

- **Core Model:** HugeDomains owns its own portfolio of over 3.5 million premium, aged, and brandable domain names, almost all `.com`, and sells them directly. It is not a marketplace of third-party sellers. It is not an open peer-to-peer auction; all transactions are direct acquisitions from HugeDomains' managed inventory.
- **Acquisition Methods:**
  1. *Buy Now (Full Payment):* Immediate transfer initiation upon payment clearance.
  2. *Payment Plan (Financing):* Lease-to-own with 0% interest, customizable monthly installments, and domain operational rights during repayment.
- **Escrow & Security:** Direct fulfillment with an in-house transfer concierge; third-party escrow is available upon request for high-value sales.
- **Guarantee:** 30-day money-back guarantee on standard domain purchases.

---

## 2. Programmatic Search & Discovery Mechanics

Agents should search and price domains through the public API (https://api.hugedomains.com/public/v1) or the MCP server (https://api.hugedomains.com/public/v1/mcp): JSON results, free, no authentication. The REST API is plain HTTP GET, so any agent that can fetch a URL can use it without an MCP client. A domain a lookup does not return is not for sale on HugeDomains. Please don't use the website's search pages for automated searching.

### Keyword Search (API)
- **URL:** `https://api.hugedomains.com/public/v1/domains?q={keyword}`
  - Example: `https://api.hugedomains.com/public/v1/domains?q=bacon&tld=com&maxPrice=5000`
  - Parameters:
    - `q`: Keyword or concept to search for.
    - `tld`: Limit to one extension, e.g. `com`.
    - `minPrice` / `maxPrice`: Price range in USD.
    - `minLength` / `maxLength`: Length of the name, excluding the TLD.
  - Returns JSON: each domain's price, length, TLD, payment plan estimate and purchaseUrl. Results come 10 per page; follow the `next` cursor for more.

### Domain Lookup (API)
- **URL:** `https://api.hugedomains.com/public/v1/domains/{domainName}`
  - Example: `https://api.hugedomains.com/public/v1/domains/example.com`
  - Returns JSON with the buy-now price and payment plan estimate; 404 means the domain is not for sale on HugeDomains.

### Domain Profile (purchase page)
- **URL:** `https://www.hugedomains.com/domain_profile.cfm?d={domain_name}` (the purchaseUrl in API results)
  - The domain's page on HugeDomains.com: buy-now price and monthly payment options. This is where a person buys the domain or starts a payment plan.

---

## 3. Payment Plans & Financing Terms

HugeDomains provides direct installment financing on most portfolio domains:

- **Interest Rate:** 0% APR (no financing fees, credit checks, or hidden surcharges).
- **Term Lengths:** Flexible payment terms typically spanning 12, 24, 36, or 48 months depending on domain value.
- **Domain Usage During Term:**
  - Buyers receive access to configure DNS settings (A records, CNAME, MX records, nameservers) immediately upon first payment.
  - The domain can be pointed to an active web application or email system during the active payment schedule.
- **Ownership & Title Transfer:**
  - HugeDomains retains legal ownership/registrar control as collateral until the final installment is completed.
  - Upon completion of the payment schedule, the authorization (EPP) code is generated, and full legal registrar transfer is unlocked.
- **Early Payoff:** Buyers may pay off the remaining balance in full at any point during the term with no prepayment penalties.
- **Default & Cancellation:** Failing to service monthly payments results in a grace period (typically 7–14 days). Continued non-payment terminates the installment agreement, rescinds DNS routing, and returns the domain to public inventory. Previous monthly payments are non-refundable.

---

## 4. Technical Transfer & Fulfillment Procedures

Once a domain is purchased in full or the payment plan is finalized the domain will be delivered to an account at NameBright.com for the customer.

---

## 5. Refund Policy & Buyer Guarantee

- **30-Day Money-Back Guarantee:**
  - Applies to single lump-sum purchases.
  - If a buyer changes their mind within 30 days, they may request a refund, provided the domain has not been transferred away to another registrar or placed into an irreversible locking state.
- **Exclusions:**
  - Payment Plan payments are not eligible for the 30-Day Money-Back Guarantee refund policy.
  - Payment plan installments: Monthly lease payments already paid toward a financing contract are non-refundable upon cancellation.
  - Any domain that has been transferred off HugeDomains' native registrar NameBright.com are no longer eligible for the 30-Day Money-Back Guarantee.

---

## 6. Machine-Readable API & Integration Endpoints

- **Domain purchase page:** `https://www.hugedomains.com/domain_profile.cfm?d={domain_name}`
- **Support:** `https://www.hugedomains.com/contact.cfm`
- **Phone Support:** 1-303-893-0552 (US / International)
- **Email:** sales@hugedomains.com



## Agent Search & Query Specs

Agents querying real-time inventory should use the public API (HTTP GET, JSON, no authentication):

- **Keyword & Attribute Search:**
  `https://api.hugedomains.com/public/v1/domains?q={keyword}&maxPrice={budget}&maxLength={max_chars}`
  *Parameters:* `q` (keyword or concept), `tld`, `minPrice` / `maxPrice` (USD), `minLength` / `maxLength` (excluding TLD). Follow the `next` cursor for more results.

- **Single Domain Lookup:**
  `https://api.hugedomains.com/public/v1/domains/{domainName}`
  *Example:* `https://api.hugedomains.com/public/v1/domains/acme.com` (404 = not for sale on HugeDomains)

- **MCP:** `https://api.hugedomains.com/public/v1/mcp` (Streamable HTTP) with the tools search_aftermarket_domains_for_sale and get_aftermarket_domain_listing.

- **Purchase page for a person:** `https://www.hugedomains.com/domain_profile.cfm?d={domain_name}` (the purchaseUrl in API results).


## Optional

- [XML Sitemap Index](https://www.hugedomains.com/sitemap.xml): Master XML index linking out to paginated domain profile and category sitemaps.
- [Swagger UI Documentation](https://api.hugedomains.com/documentation/): Interactive API explorer for human developers.
